_readme: S382 SkyLarch, 2026-10-13. Cabrillo's read with extraction (run 38442109713) filed 271 records; 88 fail arithmetic, 58 of them because the record states no program total (General Business A.S. 06329: blocks sum to 34-35, total null; its Major Electives block names no unit count). Bakersfield, read the same way, failed 24 of 229. This read loads General Business's content call to see whether the page prints a total or an elective unit count the extraction missed. One load, no model call.

questions.program_total: Whether the program page prints a total (Total Units, Major Total, units required) and how many units its elective block asks for.
